svg.title: Takeaway
svg.desc: Return to the five ELI16 stories: history and support, priorities and budgets, delivery closure, approved commitments, and a library catalogue with explicit freshness. M5 completes the bounded fifteen-family inventory with four Relations operations and exact-attribute Search. The native consumer discovers five roots, fifteen relations and eight payloads without supplied answer references. Lag, catch-up, rebuild, restart and independent replacement are demonstrated through declared interfaces. M1–M4 regressions pass, including real chain; no new cognition, numerical behavior or chain work is added. Separate module, operation and behavior coverage says precisely what was demonstrated. Private data and identifiers remain private. The useful result is a tested local integration with explicit limits.
svg.text: Real Hive → exact query → relations → real DeTTa payloads
with explicit freshness, independent owners and restart.
M5 COMPLETE · ALL 12 REQUIRED GATES PASS
